info.title: Attack a Country: Information
info.description: Choose a target country and review the land, naval, and air power comparison before beginning a military operation. Check fleet readiness and active attacks, as an attack can change diplomatic relations and a country's condition.

table.empty: Country rankings are not available yet.

fuel.fallback: Database rates are unavailable; a temporary estimate is being used.
fuel.warning: Warning: remaining oil is below the daily steam power plant requirement ({amount} barrels).

blocked.title: Attack in Progress
blocked.message: Your forces are moving toward {ongoingTarget}. Complete that attack and wait for the troops to arrive and the battle results to be processed before attacking {requestedTarget}.

launch.title: Military Operations Command
launch.warning: A direct attack on {target} is an act of open military aggression. If victorious, you can annex the country and expand your territory!

result.victoryDescription: The armed forces of {player} broke through the enemy defenses and took control of {country}!
result.defeatDescription: {country}'s military defenses were too strong. The frontline forces had to regroup.
result.chooseAction: Choose annexation or a tactical option:
result.annexDescription: Take and integrate all of {country}'s territory into {player}.
result.plunderDescription: Seize the treasury and natural resources of {country} without annexing its territory.
result.retreatDescription: Withdraw your forces without taking further action.
